title: Putnami CLI result envelope
description: Canonical machine-readable envelope emitted by putnami commands in --output=json mode.

command.description: Full command path, e.g. "build" or "cloud status".

data.description: Command-specific payload (a run summary, a list, ...).

exitCode.description: Process exit code the command returns (see the exit-code taxonomy).

code.description: Stable error class matching the exit-code taxonomy.

next.description: Suggested next command or doc link the user can run to recover, or empty.
